item.title: Daily Minute — October 17, 2026
item.description:
Remember always that your identity is shared, and that its sharing IS its reality.
You have a part to play in the Atonement, but the plan of the Atonement IS beyond you. You do not know how to overlook errors, or you would not make them. item.title: Lesson 115: For morning and evening review:
item.description: For morning and evening review: [99] “Salvation is my only function here.” My function here is to forgive the world for all the errors I have made. For thus Am I released from them with all the world. [100] “My part is essential to God’s plan for salvation.” I am essential to the plan of God For the salvation of the world.
